standfirst: Two human checks and nine automated checks. Run Step 0 first. When done—or as soon as something fails—press Copy results as text and paste it into the task.

checks: Branch must be codex/readonly-evidence-smoke-inputs-ledger. Tested source commit: 49dfe07c09111197b8739aac2df0cea43c985cdf. A later commit containing only checkpoint artifacts is allowed; the canary verifies ancestry and that source files have not changed.

Canary must report PASS: the current builder rejects a changed workbook byte and preserves the old HTML; the starting f918fe39762c70edb9a3424e54eaa208fd7c5727 builder accepts or ignores that same change. If it behaves the old way, stop and report it.

sections.title: Workbook and delivered files
sections.need: Excel or a compatible application; use the supplied disposable working copy.

steps.do: Open the original workbook, inspect its three sheets, then close without saving. Follow the exact working-copy instructions. In the copy change Orders!C2 from 2 to 3, then reset the copy using the supplied command.
steps.pass: Original sheets are Orders, Summary and Types; IDs retain 0001–0004. Original F2=22.50, total=23.50 and count=4. The copy recalculates F2=33.75 and total=34.75; resetting restores 22.50/23.50. The original remains unchanged.
steps.aside: Runner: human. Excel or a compatible spreadsheet application with calculation enabled is required. Automated validation does not claim this application step was performed.

steps.do: Follow the workbook and instruction links. Open the Before demonstration and mark demo step 1 Pass. For demo step 2, select Works, but, enter “keep this note” in the visible note field, then select Pass. Open the After demonstration in the same browser and press Copy results as text.
steps.pass: Files and copy/reset directions are usable. On After, the changed-input demo step has rerun-required history; Copy results as text reports “1. NOT RE-RUN — previous PASS”. The unaffected step retains Pass and “keep this note”. Demo marks are separate from this C1 verdict.
steps.aside: Runner: human. The demo changes synthetic files and isolated browser marks only.

steps.do: Run the Git-evidence disposable scenarios through the production helper and its fixed CLI commands.
steps.pass: All cases pass; evidence retains explicit source/ref/SHAs and contained/not-contained/unknown ancestry. Repository and remote state remain unchanged.
steps.aside: Runner: agent. Generated isolated Git repositories come from the committed tests/support/git-fixture.cjs; no manual repository construction.
